name: Grade 8 IT Summative: Vector Graphics
description: Ten core first-trimester words for the Grade 8 vector graphics vocabulary table.

words.definition: An image made from shapes and paths that can scale cleanly.
words.example: The logo stayed sharp because it was made as a vector graphic.
The bitmap looked blurry after the student enlarged the image.
The student changed the fill color of the circle to blue.

words.definition: The outline of a shape or path.
words.example: The designer made the stroke thicker around the icon.
The student changed the z-order so the title appeared in front of the shape.

words.definition: A basic form such as a circle, box, or triangle.
words.example: The poster icon was built from a circle, rectangle, and triangle shape.

words.definition: A level used to organize objects in a design.
words.example: The background layer stayed behind the logo and text.

words.definition: One separate item in a design.
words.example: The student selected one object before resizing it.

words.definition: A line or shape made from points.
words.example: The curved path formed the outline of the custom icon.

words.definition: A point that controls part of a path.
words.example: Moving one node changed the curve of the path.
